notes.title: OSX Controller Update Rollback for Overcooked! 2
notes.notes:
Hey Chefs,

With the number of issues affecting Steam players when we launched the OSX Controller Update yesterday, we have decided to roll the Steam version of Overcooked! 2 back to the version that was live before the update.

This will allow our team more time to fix the issues regarding keybinds before we release the update again to improve controller compatibility in Overcooked! 2.

More info around this can be found here: https://bit.ly/OC2-Rollback


Thank you for your patience around this. We appreciate all of your feedback, as we continue to work on improving Overcooked! 2!

As always, if you encounter any issues with Overcooked! 2, please leave a post in the Report A Problem forum. 

If you'd like to provide any feedback, we appreciate any comments on either this post, or in our General Discussions.

notes.title: Overcooked! 2 - Analytics Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, Chefs! 👨‍🍳 

Thank you for your patience and feedback, as we have worked on improving online matchmaking with our previous updates! ✨ 

As part of our efforts to improve online play, we have added analytics, so we can gather enough data to help us determine what is causing some players to have a different experience when playing with others. This update does not have crossplay, and is for PC (Steam) only 
  
This update is purely to help us figure out how we can improve online matchmaking for all players. The update will only collect anonymous multiplayer error rates data, and not personal player data.🍳

Our chefs over in the Team17 kitchen will be working hard as we perfect the recipe to a tasty multiplayer experience in the coming weeks. Many thanks for your patience whilst we look into this! 🙇

notes.title: Online Matchmaking Update for Overcooked! 2
notes.notes:
Hey there, Chef Pals! 👨‍🍳

Thank you for your patience while we have been investigating some connection and matchmaking issues you have been experiencing recently with Overcooked! 2. 

Following our previous update where we released this on the beta branch, we are now releasing the online matchmaking update on the main branch!

Patch Notes:
The game will now look to match players based on local geographic regions, matching those with similar latency to improve the overall online experience.

Linux Instructions 
Players will need to install the latest Linux build and will be required to side install “sudo apt-get install libc++-dev” or “sudo apt-get -y install libc++1” through the console.


As always, please report to our customer support here if you encounter any issues with the game or with this update: help@team17support.com

notes.title: Online Update 1 for Overcooked! 2 Crossplay Branch
notes.notes:
Attention, Chefs! 

We are aware of the current issues affecting your gameplay experience, and so we are releasing this patch to allow us to gather some important data that will help us investigate any pressing issues in Overcooked! 2. This will be for the crossplay branch only. 

The development and QA team have spent a considerable amount of time over the last few months trying to replicate and identify the online issues reported by the community, and it's one of our highest priorities to address these so we can provide a stable online experience for our players. However, due to the complexity of online networking, it has been difficult for us to narrow down the specific causes of multiplayer issues. This patch will be valuable in helping us to provide the missing information we need so an effective fix can be made, as well as confirm any fixes we make are successful.  

The analytics we will be tracking: 


 User Location (region) 
 Platform played on. 
 Has the user succeeded/failed logging into T17OS. 
 Has the user succeeded/failed platform Privilege check. 
 Detailed information about the Gamelift session including creating/joining/leaving/Session Length and general fail information. (Gamelift is a service provided by Amazon that we use for hosting online sessions) 
 Detailed information about the T17OS session including creating/joining/leaving/Session Length and general fail information. 
 Detailed information about the Platform session including creating/joining/leaving/Session Length and general fail information. 
 Information about the P2P connection including number of fails and why it is failing. 
 NAT type information.  


Will I be able to opt out of this patch?
By accepting the EULA when you first reach the main menu, you will be opted into having analytics data collected. However, you may opt out at any point by going to “Settings> Game Settings > Analytics Reporting" and unchecking the tick box. 

As always, if you encounter any problems with the game, please email our support team: help@team17support.com

notes.title: Overcooked 2 PC Crossplay Update Change
notes.notes:
Hello chefs,

With the number of issues affecting Steam players since we launched the crossplay update, we have decided to roll the Steam version of Overcooked 2 back to the version that was live before the update. 
However, this does mean that PC crossplay will not be available for a short while until we get the update issues fixed. 

We know that there may be some players who will be disappointed that they won’t be able to play with their PC friends on other platforms when we make this change, but this will allow our team more time to fix the issues affecting PC crossplay before we release the update again.


Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Overcooked! 2: Chinese New Year – FREE update available now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32971870/6c9b3d34a9f5f3282b9e56621db25ecf9f2059e2.jpg

Hello chefs!

We’re celebrating Chinese New Year in style with a free update for Overcooked! 2 which includes new kitchens, new recipes, new chefs, AND a whole new game mode! 

Check out the official launch trailer below…

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5v_YzdHLjEY&feature=youtu.be

New Map, New Kitchens
In this piece of seasonal content, you’ll be transported to a new map to take on seven new kitchens in beautiful new surroundings, themed to celebrate Chinese New Year. Beware though, these new kitchens have surprises for you (watch out for the dancing dragon!)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32971870/1bc9749167964d379eef397ca0260afa887d43cb.jpg

New Recipes
You’ll get to prepare two new mouth-watering recipes: fruit platter and hot pot!
The delicious fruit platter is a traditional Chinese New Year dish that signifies fullness and wealth. While the hot pot is a dish to enjoy with family and friends. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32971870/6e2692a934029d881569266b85d424f55d828045.jpg

New Chefs
We’ve included two brand new chefs to represent you in the kitchen in this update. Get ready to turn up the heat with the fiery ornate Chinese dragon and celebrate 2019 as the Year of the Pig with our wonderful new pig chef!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32971870/aa330de79ea14c0636e87ff5a4290d296e85189e.jpg

New Game Mode
Also included in this update is ‘Survival Mode’, where every dish you serve will add seconds to the timer and you’ll be cooking against the clock to survive for as long as possible! Survival Mode is available for all kitchens of the main game, the Surf ‘n’ Turf DLC and both seasonal updates.

And by popular demand, we’ve also added a ‘replay’ button on the results screen, so you can jump straight back into the same kitchen if you’re trying to beat your high score or just simply want to play again!

Along with this content, we’ve done some bug squishing and issue fixing too! Check out the full changelist below, for more information.

Changelist

Changes

 New seasonal update content – available in the ‘Extras’ menu.
 New ‘Survival Mode’ – available to play from the World Map.
 Added an option to replay a kitchen from the results screen.

Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the highlight might disappear after selecting an invite from various screens.
 Fixed an issue where plated recipes might not appear correctly following a player disconnecting in online games.
 Fixed an issue with the audio on the main menu not playing correctly.
 Various minor bug fixes and improvements.


Launch Activity:
Official Livestream: We’ll be hosting an official launch day livestream and answering your questions in chat! Tune in today, at 5pm GMT on Twitch, Mixer, Facebook, YouTube and Steam!

Steam Broadcasts: We’ve got special guests broadcasting their cooking chaos live right here on Steam. Tune in to the Overcooked! 2 Steam store page throughout the day to see how our guest chefs fare in the new kitchens!

notes.title: Overcooked! 2 - Shared Progress update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

If you do any of your cooking with other chefs online, we've just put out an update that should make this experience even better. Today's update adds "shared progress" saving, which now saves story progress to the profiles of all online chefs!

“With the Shared Progress update, levels played in Story mode online will now be saved for all online players. This means levels will be unlocked, stars awarded, and your best score saved for everyone when completing a level, whether you are the host or the client!”

We hope this update will make your online cooking even better, and are looking forward to seeing even more of you 4-starring kitchens together!

Full patch notes for today's update:
New functionality for Clients in online Story mode games to save progress.
Fixed an issue where input from certain PS4 controllers was not being recognised in-game on OSX.
Fixed an error that occurred if a client left an online game during the intro cutscene.
Fixed the button text on the controls screen displaying in the incorrect language for Japanese/Simplified Chinese/Korean.
As always, please do let us know what you think of the update, and what you'd love to see next. We've still got a lot of cool updates coming, and can't wait to share more with you soon. Those of you on consoles can rest assured that we'll be bringing these updates to all platforms as soon as possible!

See you in the kitchen!

notes.title: On The Menu: Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!

We’re aiming to put out an update next week that will address some of the issues players have encountered, including a softlock crash and a bug which has caused the chef unlocks to only happen for the host of an online game. Fixing this softlock issue should also help with the players that have been having online disconnection issues as we believe this is linked to hosts experiencing softlocks.

We’ve also been tracking feedback about two issues:

Key rebinds: We’re seeing the demand loud and clear for the ability to change key bindings and we’ve begun work on implementing this into the game. It’s not going to happen immediately but it’s one of our top priorities and we’ll let you know when you can expect to see it in the game.

Player progress for campaign co-op: Due to the way save games currently work with each of the players joining a host, only the host of the online session retains progress so we’re looking into a redesign of the current system. Our aim is to make it so that all players will be able to share progress when playing as a group online. We’re already investigating the best route forward and will update the community as to when we expect to be able to integrate this into the game.

If you experience any other issues, please continue to post in the Report A Problem forum.

Thanks!
